text: これこそ　しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will truly remain in Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing, like 'that...' in English. れきしに のこる いだいな しごと = 'a great work that will remain in history'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is how old men in stories say だ, 'it is'; here it is stretched out in excitement. しごとじゃー = 'it is a work!'

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word stresses it: 'this one above all'. これこそ = 'this is the very thing'.
